data.title: Help the Plants Grow
data.description: Each plant needs your help. Give it what it needs, then watch it grow!

challenges.instruction: Here is a little bean plant seedling and an empty pot. Give it everything it needs to grow, and nothing it does not need. Then press Watch it grow.
This sunflower is drooping. Find what it is missing and fix it, then press Watch it grow.
Here is a little daisy seedling and an empty pot. Give it everything it needs to grow, and nothing it does not need. Then press Watch it grow.
This tomato plant is drooping. Find what it is missing and fix it, then press Watch it grow.
Here is a little bean plant seedling and an empty pot. Give it everything it needs to grow, and nothing it does not need. Then press Watch it grow.
